newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Bank says Chairman Dean resigns.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Bank says Chairman Dean resigns.

text.p: The Pacific Bank on Thursday said Norman Dean will step down from his position as Chairman of the Board of Directors, and he will be replaced by Michael Tun Zan.
Tun Zan will retain his positions as president and chief executive officer.

Dean joined the Bank's Board in late 1991 and was named chairman and chief executive officer in October 1992. Under Dean's leadership, the bank was recapitalized and asset quality was significantly to the point where non-performing assets, as a percentage of assets, fell to 0.37 percent.
